title: Installment-Record Allowance on Portal Bank-Debit Payments (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Cashiering standard clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the installment-record allowance, which rewards installments the consumer has paid under Payment Arrangements on the account.

## Clause

The installment-record allowance is:
- **$200.00** where the account's payment plans record 3 or more paid installments after deducting their returned installments;
- **$100.00** where they record at least one but fewer than 3 such installments;
- **nothing** where they record none.

The allowance is added at its full amount in working out the portal bank-debit ceiling of the day.

## How the installments are counted

1. Take every installment-paid entry on the plan ledgers of all the Payment Arrangements plans of the placed account, whatever their dates and whatever the status of the plan.
2. Deduct the number of installment-returned entries on those same plan ledgers.
3. The result is the number of paid installments after deducting returned installments.

No month window applies; the whole plan history of the account counts. Missed installments are not part of the count.

## Condition table

| Paid installments less returned installments | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $200.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $100.00 |
| 0 or fewer | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented plan ledgers.*

| Plans on the account | Paid entries | Returned entries | Net | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| One Standard Installment Plan | 5 | 1 | 4 | $200.00 |
| A broken Short-Term Installment Plan and a later Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 2 and 1 | 1 and 0 | 2 | $100.00 |
| One plan | 1 | 1 | 0 | nothing |
| No plan ever set up | 0 | 0 | 0 | nothing |
